business_summary: China Marine Information Electronics Company Limited engages in the research and development, manufacture, and sale of electronic defense and information equipment in China and internationally. The company offers underwater defense products used for underwater information detection and countermeasures, acquisition, transmission, system control, and underwater acoustics; dedicated computer products, such as computers, servers, storage devices, and network equipment, as well as module-level products which include hardware, firmware, software, and structures. It also provides motion control products, including shaft angle converters, encoders, motion control systems, control equipment, and integrated electromechanical systems; power supply products, such as modular, radar, pulse, integrated, and intelligent power management systems; and satellite communication and navigation systems and equipment, proprietary multi-mode GNSS chips, multi-mode receivers, Beidou terminal positioning equipment, safety protection systems for offshore mobile platforms, and mobile marine observation and survey equipment. In addition, the company offers electrical connector products; oil and gas related equipment; smart city-related products; smart ocean related products; intelligent processing and manufacturing systems, intelligent cleaning machines for industrial robots, and intelligent assembly lines; and intelligent cleaning vehicles for solar thermal power plant mirrors. It serves ships, weapons, aviation, aerospace, electronics, nuclear power, high-speed trains, industrial robots, high-end CNC machine tools, and other industries. China Marine Information Electronics Company Limited was founded in 1993 and is based in Beijing, China.
